title: Ideogram Ships First Vector Model for Editable SVG Generation
summary:
The AI startup now allows designers to create resolution-independent files from text prompts and existing images. The company's new tool produces scalable graphics with smooth gradients and sharp typography, permitting modifications that are not possible with traditional pixel-based images. This capability is currently accessible through the Ideogram platform and via its API.

The tool also launched on the fal platform, where it supports the use of reference images to guide the generation process. This release is the first lauch of a model dedicated to vector output from Ideogram, expanding its technical offering beyond the raster image generation for which it is previously known.
